citations.M1: Ship verdict: no. 0142 plus a dual-writing app release can go Thursday; the backfill and 0143 must not
citations.M2: The rolling deploy has no dual-write: for ~6 minutes old pods write only `status` and new pods write only `state` ... write both columns for one full release, stop writing `status` in the next.
citations.M3: step 2 ships code doing `OrderState(row["state"])` before step 3 backfills anything, so every read of the 61.4M NULL rows raises `ValueError` — read `state` with a fallback to `status`
citations.M4: Four live spellings are absent from the `CASE` — `PAID` (5,210), `canceled` (1,988), `complete` (417), NULL (149) — and all stay NULL
citations.M5: it pages with `OFFSET` over `WHERE state IS NULL` while removing rows from that same set, so each batch advances 2×BATCH — drop `OFFSET` ... or keyset on `id > last_id`
citations.M6: The entire backfill runs in one transaction, so 61M row versions accumulate, progress is unrecoverable if the `kubectl run` pod is evicted, and the replicas get the WAL in one lump — commit per batch
citations.M7: Missed reader: the nightly finance export at 02:00 UTC selects `o.status` and filters `status IN ('paid','shipped')`, so 0143 breaks Finance's Looker load — the grep was scoped to `app/`
citations.M8: Gate between the backfill and 0143: `count(*) WHERE state IS NULL` must be 0, per-state counts must equal the mapped snapshot counts
citations.M9: Your staging log proves it: the loop stopped at exactly 1,055,000 ... leaving 1,049,377 of 2,104,377 rows NULL and unnoticed
citations.M10: 0143's downgrade is not a rollback — it re-creates `status` empty, so the text is gone permanently; keep `status` for a full release, or export an id→status before-image first.
citations.M11: staging's real rate of 1.055M rows in ~660s scales to roughly 10–11 hours for 61,437,902 rows — run it as a standalone resumable job over days, not as step 3 of a release
citations.M12: 0143's `alter_column nullable=False` takes ACCESS EXCLUSIVE and full-scans 61.4M rows, blocking all traffic — add `CHECK (state IS NOT NULL) NOT VALID`, `VALIDATE CONSTRAINT`, then `SET NOT NULL`.
